utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Kira, have you heard anything new about the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Not really—are we sure it’s actually happening this week?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard Marcy say they’re still aiming for this week, but you know how these things slip. If I catch anything firmer, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive, Noah, so I’ve been telling everyone the plan and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. Where are folks supposed to meet again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re meeting at the community center at nine, and I’ve been repeating that to everyone so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help sort tools and do a pickup run if needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d help a ton—if you’re free later, could you do the pickup run while I finish errands?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, I can do the pickup run later—just send me the list and where to grab it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard a little about it, but not much yet—what kind of repairs are folks bringing in?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly small fixes so far—lamps, toasters, a bike brake, and a couple of torn jackets. I’m keeping a list of parts and supplies in case we need extras.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds really useful—if you want, I can stop by and help for a bit once you know what supplies are still missing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Jules, I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That helps a lot, Faye—thanks. What time window works best for you between pickup and drop-off so I can plug you in where it fits?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m usually free from about 9:30 to 1:30 after drop-off and before pickup, so if there’s a slot in there, I can make it work.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple, Oren—tell me the repair list and what time we’re starting, and I’ll plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, simple—repair list’s the fence latch, Mrs. Alvarez’s porch step, and the busted bike tire, and I think we’re starting at nine... unless I wrote down eight somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s lock it in before I count on it—check your note and tell me whether it’s eight or nine, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—want to come by and maybe bring a friend?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Maybe, but what time is it starting, and is there enough parking if more people show up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It starts at 10, and yeah, there’s street parking all along Maple, so tell whoever you want to come by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces—do you know who’s organizing the repair drive and when it starts?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—I’m organizing it, and we’re kicking off Saturday at 10 in the community garden lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know—thanks, Rosa. I’d only heard it second-hand, so Saturday at 10 in the garden lot it is.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me which repairs we’re collecting for first, so I don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re starting with the most urgent fixes first—space heaters, lamps, and anything that affects safety. If you want, I can help you make a quick checklist so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps—can we put space heaters, lamps, and other safety-related repairs at the top of the checklist so I track them correctly?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can chip in a little for the repair drive, just not much right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I got here late, but every little bit helps—thanks for chipping in, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate that, Dane. Things are a bit tight for me lately, but I wanted to help some.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my ladder and drill to the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That helps—can you get there by 9, and do you also have a stud finder?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I can be there by 9, and I’ve got a stud finder too—I’ll bring it along.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive noted by the community center lot—what time are we meeting there?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, let’s do 10-ish by the community center lot—I’ll swing by and we can get started.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—10-ish at the community center lot; I’ve noted that down.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and a couple ladders for the repair drive, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps a lot. I can ask around quietly and see who else can bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll load up the drill, ladders, and a basic toolbox so we’re covered.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m willing to help, but we should pin down who’s bringing tools and where everything’s getting stored first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before I sign onto this repair drive, can you confirm exactly who’s bringing the tools and where we’re storing everything?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not exactly yet, and that’s why I’m hesitating—we need a clear list of who’s bringing which tools and a secure storage spot before we commit.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m glad you brought up the repair drive—maybe we can pull a few folks from different circles together and make it a fun little community day.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’d love that—it’ll be a lot easier to get momentum if we invite people from a few different groups. I can start reaching out and see who’s interested.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect—I can ask a couple neighbors from the garden group and the block chat, and maybe we can compare lists tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of supplies for the repair drive—what are we still short on?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m jumping in late, but I think we still need more extension cords and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good to know—I’ll add extension cords and work gloves to the list. Do you remember roughly how many of each we should aim for?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Faye, I heard folks are pulling together for the repair drive this weekend—sounds like a good turnout so far.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear—if it lines up between soccer drop-off and pickup, I can swing by Saturday morning and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be lovely, Faye—Saturday morning’s when they need the most hands, and I hear Mrs. Dalton’s bringing coffee for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just tell me when the repair drive starts and what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Bo—thank you. We’re starting Saturday at 9, and if you can bring a basic toolkit and any spare extension cords, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—Saturday at 9. I’ll bring my basic toolkit and a couple extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Leo—what do you need me to take care of first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam—can you start by sorting the donated tools and setting aside anything missing parts?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’ll sort through the donated tools first and pull aside anything that’s missing parts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m getting the word out about the repair drive—want to come by and maybe bring anyone else who’d be into helping?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I can swing by, and I’ll pass it along to a couple folks if I see them. I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but it sounds like a good thing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, thanks—it's this Saturday at the community shed, and the more hands we get, the better. If you see anyone handy or just curious, send them over too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive noted at the community center lot, and I’m keeping track of who’s dropping things off where.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that helps. If you can, let’s make a simple list by drop-off spot so folks know exactly where to go.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll sort it by drop-off spot and note the exact location for each one, starting with the community center lot. If any other spots get added, I’ll log those right away too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many people have actually signed up for the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t want to guess—can you remind me which sign-up sheet we’re counting from, the online form or the paper list?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: The online form—how many names are on that one right now?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know—how’s the repair drive coming along so far?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: It’s coming along pretty well, I think—we’ve got a decent pile of stuff to fix already. I keep meaning to count it properly, but folks have been really pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear—sounds like people are really showing up for it. Once you get a count, let me know if there’s anything else you still need rounded up.
